turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Where does the zero come from?
Thanks for coming in. The zero went in before I called you, and that was wrong.
Okay. I'm writing that down. Now tell me what you have, Hale.
I will remove the zero tomorrow morning. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch on Thursday. Nothing goes on his record. I will put all of that in an email to you tonight.
Tomorrow morning, not today. And a rewrite for what, Hale? What is your basis for making Owen prove anything, when you haven't shown me one document?
Yes, all of it, in writing tonight.
I'll read the email when it arrives. But I asked for your basis, Hale, and "yes" isn't one. I'm waiting.
Okay, I think that is the end of the meeting. Thank you.
It isn't over, Hale. You still haven't told me what you based the zero on. Answer that, and then we can talk about your email.
